capabilities: Automatically tag and link notes to related notes via an LLM
Create new notes with a template from the sidebar
Query the vault with natural-language questions
Keep the graph and vector database updated as notes change
Run the LLM locally through Ollama or through the Gemini API
extras: An LLM is required for the main workflow, either locally via Ollama (models must be downloaded first) or via a Gemini API key; the README references an architecture diagram and workflow code in the repository's workflows folder.
motivation: The author kept abandoning note-taking because finding and applying an organization method took more time than creating the notes themselves.
problem: Organizing notes manually takes so much effort that users get stuck researching note-taking methods instead of writing content.

relations.evidence: put it into the plugin settings and it will use it to organize and query your notes

summary: LLM-powered organizer that automatically tags and links new notes to related notes using the Zettelkasten method, with natural-language querying.
